subject: Cascading 5xx on /v1/generate — compensation & remediation
content:
From: Elena Morales <elena@acmeops.com>
To: support@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Elevated 5xx/429 across generate — immediate impact to prod

Hi team,

We observed a sudden increase in 5xx and 429 responses from your /v1/generate endpoint starting ~08:50 UTC this morning. That caused a large number of client retries and caused timeouts in our user-facing flows. Our telemetry shows:~20% of requests returned 5xx during the 30 minute window, average latency spiked from 120ms to 1.8s, and a retry cascade on our side. Revenue-impacting.

Can you confirm root cause and advise on timelines for remediation? We will need to open a credit conversation if this maps to an SLA breach.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Engineering, AcmeOps
[Attachment: api-error-dump-aug20.log (text, 1.2MB)]

----
From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: support@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-20T10:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Elevated 5xx/429 across generate — immediate impact to prod

Forwarding AcmeOps alert. Initial ops triage: 5xx spike correlated with a surge of long-context requests that blew through the KV cache and triggered fallbacks to un-quantized replicas; there were cascading timeouts and a small number of unhealthy pods.

Immediate asks:
- Monica: diagnostics + event timeline (I tagged INF-2193).
- Lauren: coordinate customer comms and put draft credit/comp template together.
- Aditya: assess account health / likely escalation path; flag to sales leadership if we need credit approval.

I'll run the triage call at 10:30 UTC.

-Priyom
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

----
From: monica.patel@redwood.ai
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-20T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Elevated 5xx/429 across generate — immediate impact to prod

Summary from triage call:
- 08:47 UTC: traffic pattern changed (larger batch size from AcmeOps), KV cache miss rate +210%
- 08:50–09:05 UTC: autoscaler lagged on node spin-up; several pods hit p95 memory and restarted (3 restarts)
- 08:55–09:05 UTC: fallback to CPU-optimized replicas with slower kernels; resulting in 5xx and 429 as queue length increased
- 09:06 UTC: mitigations applied (cache warming + temporary rate-limiter on heavy routes).

Logs attached and I opened INF-2193 with timeline and heap dumps. Recommend:
- credit conversation (SLA exposure looks real for 08:50–09:06 window)
- longer-term mitigation: pre-warming policy for accounts that do large context batches; adjust autoscaler thresholds

Attachments: slo-uptime-report-july.pdf, api-error-dump-aug20.log

-Monica
Principal Reliability Engineer

----
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-20T11:10:00Z

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-20T11:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Elevated 5xx/429 across generate — immediate impact to prod

Hi Elena — thanks for flagging this and apologies for the disruption.

High-level: our ops team traced the issue to an unexpected traffic pattern that overwhelmed our KV cache and autoscaler. We applied mitigations at 09:06 UTC which stopped the errors and restored baseline latency. Monica has attached the timeline and logs for your review.

Next steps we propose:
- A formal root cause note and SLA exposure estimate by EOD today.
- A one-time credit proposal for the impacted window (we will send a draft credit memo and an itemized calculation).
- A technical action plan: pre-warm policy + autoscale tuning + a mutual throttling suggestion we can implement together.

We can schedule a short review with your engineers today if that helps.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: proposed-credit-memo.pdf (PDF, 21KB)]

Hi Elena — following up on Lauren's note. We appreciate the impact this caused. Based on Monica's timeline, our initial compensation proposal is a 25% credit for the hourly usage during 08:50–09:06 UTC, plus a one-time professional services voucher to help implement pre-warm and autoscale tuning.

Details:
- Credit calculation: 25% of billed tokens + an immediate $5k PS voucher redeemable against our Dedicated onboarding or private configuration work.
- We will issue the credit within 10 business days after you confirm.
- If you prefer a higher credit, we can escalate to commercial leadership for review; please advise.

Are you available for a short call tomorrow to finalize?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
